chunks: And Abu al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام said:
"A man ought to provide generously for his family so that they do not wish for his death."

key_terms.عَلَى: upon; indicating the direction of care and spending
key_terms.عِيَالِهِ: his dependents or family members under his care
key_terms.لِلرَّجُلِ: for the man; referring to the household provider
key_terms.يَنْبَغِي: it is proper or fitting; indicates moral appropriateness
key_terms.يُوَسِّعَ: to be generous or ample in spending

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام say about providing for one's family?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام teaches that a man should be generous and expansive in supporting his dependents. The hadith emphasizes the ethical and social importance of proper family maintenance, so that hardship and deprivation do not breed resentment within the household.
